configurations.name: elevatorbeat
configurations.//: The site is static, so this is only a file server. `python3 -m http.server` takes its port as a positional argument and ignores $PORT, which breaks automatic port assignment as soon as two sessions are open at once — hence the inline server, which reads $PORT and falls back to 8642.
runtimeArgs: import os, functools, http.server, socketserver; socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True; socketserver.TCPServer(('', int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8642'))), functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=os.getcwd())).serve_forever()
